question: What sets occupation policies and nationalism in a new game at a later bookmark: how a province history's controller and owner lines are applied

addresses.name: COwnerChange::Apply
addresses.comment: **A province history's `owner = TAG`, replayed** - slot 7 of the history entry. 0x5FE710 to the single `ret 4` at 0x5FE824 (VAs). Province at +0xC, tag at +0x10. **Forward**: the owner on entry (+0x32C/+0x330) kept at +0x18/+0x1C, then **CMapProvince::ChangeOwner(province, &tag, &date, 0, 0, 0)** (rva 0xA36C0) - the change of owner itself: the new owner takes control first (Province_SetController, so the occupation-policy step of a capture), owns it, and **sets nationalism to YEARS_OF_NATIONALISM where the old owner was a real country, whether or not the owner changed**. This settles what occupation.md had inferred from the 1936 start save (five provinces with two history files, and only those, at 19.917) and is what gives every province whose owner a dated line changed before a later bookmark its nationalism (1939.9.1: 560 of 560 provinces as the save). **Back**: CMapProvince::SetOwner(province, &kept, &date, 0, 0) (rva 0xA2180), then Province_SetController(province, &kept, &date, 0, 0, 0). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-laterstart.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: vtable.py --holding 0x5FE710: COwnerChange slot 7 only (table 0x15CA100). disasm.py 0x5FE710: byte [ebp+8] tested at 0x5FE785; forward saves [province+0x32C/0x330] into [this+0x18/0x1C] (0x5FE799..0x5FE7AB) and calls 0x4A36C0 at 0x5FE7CD (pushes 0,0,0 / date / &tag, province in ecx); back calls 0x4A2180 at 0x5FE7F4 then 0x4A2400 at 0x5FE81C, both with &this+0x18. Shown wrong by ChangeOwner not being 0x4A36C0 or by its nationalism store being conditional on something the record does not say.
